_comments.source: Hand-curated 2026-04-05. Opacification of the crystalline lens, treated surgically via phacoemulsification and IOL implantation. Specialty-narrow case: ophthalmology does essentially all of it.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 66984 (standard cataract w/ IOL, one-stage) is the highest-volume procedure code in all of Medicare Part B. 66982 is complex cataract (iris expander, capsular ring, etc.). 66987/66988 bundle in MIGS (laser treatment to lower IOP) for combined cataract+glaucoma surgery. 76519 is A-scan biometry (IOL power calculation). 92004/92014 are comprehensive eye exams — required pre-op evaluation. V2632 is the IOL device code.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: Ophthalmology is overwhelmingly the specialty. Anterior-segment / cornea sub-specialists do most of the volume. Optometry participates in co-management (pre-op refraction, post-op care) but does not perform surgery.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: Core surgical technique names, IOL types, outcomes, and complications.
